answer_2.quote: we evaluate the automatically assigned labels against the gold labels provided by annotators.

answer_4.quote: we hired 12 annotators with a background in translation studies and experience in EN → T translation... to rate and validate the automatic translations of the test set
answer_4.guideline: First, we ask them to rate the translations on a scale from 1-5 (worst to best)... we show them the labeled verbal predicates in the English sentence and ask them to mark on the target side the words that express the same meaning... we ask them to fix minor translation mistakes in order to better reflect the source meaning.
